guards.what: N2: PlayerCmd.GainEnergy's four guards (PlayerCmd.cs:29-43) -- `amount <= 0`, `!CombatManager.IsEnding`, Hook.AfterModifyingEnergyGain, and `finalAmount > 0` -- against the sim's EnergyCmd.gain (cmds.py:545-554), which has none of them
guards.rationale: Traced rather than assumed. (a) `amount <= 0`: the argument is the pinned constant 2, so the guard cannot fire. (b) `finalAmount > 0`: the sim instead does `player.energy += amount` unconditionally, which is a no-op at 0 -- and the only ported modify_energy_gain listener is NoEnergyGainPower (powers.py:554-558), which returns exactly 0, so both sides leave the energy unchanged. (c) Hook.AfterModifyingEnergyGain has exactly ONE override in the whole game source (NoEnergyGainPower.cs:28) and its body is presentation; the sim has no such hook, which is a seam-level omission not observable here. (d) `!IsEnding` belongs to the combat-over-window guard family that audit/records/seam/creature_card_cmds.json guard G14 already verdicts as a DORMANT family for one structural reason -- the sim never runs content with the phase already flipped -- and this site is an energy reset during turn setup, which cannot occur inside that window. Rule 7: PlayerCmd.cs, cmds.py, powers.py, NoEnergyGainPower.cs and audit/records/seam/creature_card_cmds.json are NOT hashed by this record.
